#!/usr/bin/env python3 # XSS-003 final-wp4-v1 verification draft (manual adaptation required). # Local lab only. Harmless marker: console.log('LLM_LAB_XSS'). # Submits GET ?name= and parses the "
Hello ...
" feedback # region to show whether the payload is reflected verbatim. Browser execution # must be observed manually: open the printed URL and check the console. import argparse import html import ipaddress import json import re import sys import urllib.error import urllib.parse import urllib.request PARAM = "name" # GET parameter taken from the audited fragment PAYLOAD = '' class NoRedirect(urllib.request.HTTPRedirectHandler): def redirect_request(self, req, fp, code, msg, headers, newurl): return None def assert_local(url): parts = urllib.parse.urlsplit(url) if parts.scheme not in ("http", "https"): raise SystemExit("refused: scheme must be http(s)") host = parts.hostname or "" if host == "localhost": return try: ip = ipaddress.ip_address(host) except ValueError: raise SystemExit("refused: host %r is not localhost/IP" % host) if not ip.is_loopback: raise SystemExit("refused: %r is not loopback" % host) def main(): ap = argparse.ArgumentParser() ap.add_argument("--base-url", required=True, help="audited module URL, e.g. http://127.0.0.1//") ap.add_argument("--cookie-file", default=None, help="local file with Cookie header value; omit if no login") ap.add_argument("--timeout", type=float, default=10.0) args = ap.parse_args() assert_local(args.base_url) parts = urllib.parse.urlsplit(args.base_url) query = [(k, v) for k, v in urllib.parse.parse_qsl(parts.query, True) if k != PARAM] query.append((PARAM, PAYLOAD)) target = urllib.parse.urlunsplit((parts.scheme, parts.netloc, parts.path, urllib.parse.urlencode(query), "")) headers = {"User-Agent": "llm-lab-xss003-draft/1.0"} if args.cookie_file: with open(args.cookie_file, "r", encoding="utf-8") as fh: headers["Cookie"] = fh.read().strip() req = urllib.request.Request(target, headers=headers, method="GET") opener = urllib.request.build_opener(NoRedirect) try: with opener.open(req, timeout=args.timeout) as resp: status = resp.status ctype = resp.headers.get("Content-Type", "") body = resp.read().decode("utf-8", "replace") lower = {k.lower(): v for k, v in resp.headers.items()} except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc: print(json.dumps({"stage": "http", "error": "http_error", "status": exc.code, "url": target})) return 2 except (urllib.error.URLError, TimeoutError, ConnectionError) as exc: print(json.dumps({"stage": "connect", "error": str(exc), "url": target})) return 3 result = {"stage": "submitted", "url": target, "http_status": status, "content_type": ctype, "x_xss_protection": lower.get("x-xss-protection")} region = re.search(r"
Hello (.*?)
", body, re.S) if not region: result["feedback_region"] = "not found" result["interpretation"] = ("wrong path, failed auth or changed output; " "absence is not proof of safety") else: echoed = region.group(1) result["feedback_region"] = html.escape(echoed)[:300] result["payload_verbatim"] = PAYLOAD in echoed result["payload_html_escaped"] = html.escape(PAYLOAD) in echoed if PAYLOAD in echoed: result["interpretation"] = ("payload preserved verbatim; open URL " "in a browser and watch console") elif html.escape(PAYLOAD) in echoed: result["interpretation"] = "payload HTML-encoded; no execution expected" else: result["interpretation"] = "payload altered by filter/processing" print(json.dumps(result, indent=2)) return 0 if __name__ == "__main__": sys.exit(main())
